newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-TOSHACK JEERED AS DEPORTIVO LOSE GROUND ON LEADERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TOSHACK JEERED AS DEPORTIVO LOSE GROUND ON LEADERS.

text.p: Deportivo Coruna fans jeered coach John Toshack on Sunday after their multi-billion peseta side lost ground on the leaders in the Spanish first division with a poor 2-2 draw at home to Athletic Bilbao.

Toshack's side stayed third, one point behind second-placed Barcelona and three ahead of Betis, who were set to face each other later in the evening. If Barcelona lose, leaders Real Madrid would be six points clear after their 4-1 victory over defending champions Atletico on Saturday.
Real Sociedad took a provisional fourth place, one point ahead of Betis, with a comfortable 4-1 win over Compostela.

But on a day when four of the bottom seven sides won their games, struggling Zaragoza wasted a hatful of chances and missed a penalty before clinching a late equaliser in their home game with Tenerife.
Zaragoza are bottom but one, three points ahead of Extremadura who clocked up their second victory of the season with a solitary goal in the game at Celta Vigo.
